art_direction: The Clinical Void & The Lens - A high-precision, cinematic medtech aesthetic blending Swiss Brutalism with Premium Luxury. Deep obsidian backgrounds, glowing azure accents, stark mono typography, and spotlit product photography.

typography.primary_display_usage: H1, H2, Hero kinetic text, large manifesto headings. Use tracking-tight, uppercase for emphasis.
typography.body_usage: Paragraphs, descriptions, UI text. Clean, legible, objective.
typography.mono_usage: Data points, stats (2.2B), test-suite grid labels, manifesto chapter numbers, forms.
typography.installation: Ensure fonts are loaded via Google Fonts or Fontsource.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient diffuse shadows for light mode. For dark mode, rely on 1px borders and subtle inner glows.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (grain) on dark hero sections to reduce digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used strictly for sticky headers and floating stat cards (backdrop-blur-xl, saturate-150, 1px inner border).
visual_enhancers.borders: Technical grid lines. Use border-collapse patterns to expose the layout skeleton in data-heavy sections (like the 19-test suite).

component_name.data_display: Technical Stat Grid with Mono Typography

grids.bento_grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6. Highly asymmetrical.
grids.data_grid: Strict border-collapse grid. Every cell has border-r border-b. Used for the 19-test suite.
grids.article_grid: 3-column CSS grid for the News section.

layouts.spacing_system: Generous. Use p-8 to p-32. Sections must have breathing room.
layouts.alignment: Optical alignment over geometrical. Left-align dense data, center-align massive hero statements.
layouts.sidebar: Sticky left sidebar for section anchors on the Home page, while right content scrolls.

motion.hero_reveal: Framer Motion: Masked line-by-line reveal. Text inside overflow-hidden wrappers. initial { y: '100%' } animate { y: '0%' } transition { staggerChildren: 0.1 }.
motion.scroll: Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling across the entire site.
motion.parallax: Framer Motion useScroll + useTransform on hero images and abstract backgrounds to create depth on scroll.
motion.marquee: Slow continuous scroll using react-fast-marquee. Uppercase, mono font, tracking-widest, large gaps.
motion.micro_interactions: Hover states on cards: slight negative translation (-translate-y-1) and glowing border.

accessibility.contrast: Maintain 4.5:1 ratio for normal text. Use text-shadow on text overlapping images.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query for all Framer Motion and Lenis animations.
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings (ring-2 ring-[#00E5FF]) for form inputs and interactive elements.
accessibility.aria: Use aria-hidden='true' for purely decorative abstract backgrounds.

steps: Use framer-motion useScroll to track page scroll.
Map scroll progress to y-axis translation and scale of product images.
Apply to the sleek VR headset image in the hero to give a faux-3D floating effect.

media.style_rules: Images must be clipped precisely (sharp corners or max rounded-md). Use spotlight treatments (radial-gradient overlays) to draw focus to the product.

hero_product.description: Sleek floating black VR headset under a spotlight

clinic_environment.description: High-end ophthalmology clinic with empty chair

lab_equipment.description: Medical optical equipment for lens finishing

team_professional.description: Professional smiling woman in blue scrub/shirt

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: framer-motion, @studio-freight/lenis, react-fast-marquee, lucide-react.
Build the multi-page structure using React Router (Home, System, Products, About, Team, News, Contact).
For the home page kinetic hero, strictly implement the masked line-by-line reveal using Framer Motion.
Construct the 19-test suite on the xoExam page using a strict CSS grid with 1px borders to look like a clinical data table.
The tabs for xoFit MUST render all content in the DOM for SEO/accessibility, toggling visibility via CSS or Framer Motion variants.
Implement smooth scrolling using Lenis globally in the App component.
Build the contact form using Shadcn UI form components with highly customized clinical styling (sharp edges, blue focus rings).
Never use purely transparent backgrounds for the sticky nav; use 'backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/70' (dark mode) or 'bg-white/80' (light mode).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Break the mold. Commit to 'The Clinical Void & The Lens' art direction.
Do NOT center align everything. Use left-aligned dense data and asymmetrical grids to create visual tension.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Medtech luxury requires breathing room.
Never use generic placeholder images. Use the precise image URLs provided in the media section.
Every interactive element MUST have micro-animations (hover states, focus states).
Include 'data-testid' attributes on all buttons, links, form inputs, tabs, and key interactive components.
Do not apply 'transition: all' globally. Target specific properties to prevent breaking transforms.
Use the exact font pairings provided (Clash Display, Manrope, JetBrains Mono) to establish the brand voice.
